answer: 3 ember slots stop fakes: each member gets 3 slots, no rollover, reset at dawn. A sponsor spends one slot to admit a newcomer. The registry lists each slot for recount. Slots cost 40; newcomers lock 30, so 1,000 fakes pay 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-slot ring dies at its first caught sybil; one bad vouch sends a ripple, and its sponsor loses all slots for 3 epochs. Honest agents pay a slot plus a 30 lock, refunded after a clean epoch.
